core.title: Capabilities
core.description: Choose which optional capabilities to configure and tune the smoothing window. Each capability you enable asks its own follow-up questions later in the flow.

data_description.solar_available: Turn on if a solar installation is present. Adds Solar and SolarOnly charging modes and asks their setup next.
data_description.captar_available: Turn on if CapTar peak-shaving is available. Adds CapTar mode and asks its setup next.
data_description.deadline_available: Turn on to track a departure deadline so charging can be scheduled to finish on time. Adds the Deadline setup step next.
data_description.notifications_available: Turn on to enable notifications (deadline notices, plug-in and evening prompts). Adds the Notifications setup step next.
data_description.smoothing_window: Number of recent power samples averaged before adjusting charging current, to avoid reacting to short spikes. Default 4.

grid.title: Grid connection
grid.description: Map the entities that represent your grid connection and tune its thresholds.

data_description.net_power_entity: The sensor reporting net grid power (import positive, export negative). Used to detect solar surplus and stay under the grid ceiling.
data_description.grid_voltage_entity: Optional sensor reporting live grid voltage, used instead of the nominal voltage default when converting between power and current.
data_description.low_tariff_entity: Optional entity indicating a low electricity tariff period is active. A binary_sensor/input_boolean is used as-is; a sensor/select/input_select needs its raw states listed below.
data_description.low_tariff_states: Comma-separated raw states that count as low tariff (e.g. "low, off-peak"), for a low_tariff_entity that isn't already on/off. Leave blank if not needed.
data_description.nominal_voltage: Grid voltage (V) used to convert between power and current when no live grid voltage entity is mapped. Default 230.
data_description.grid_ceiling_a: Maximum current (A) the home's electrical connection can safely supply, including everything else in the house. Default 25.
data_description.grid_safety_offset_a: Safety margin (A) subtracted from the grid ceiling before charging current is computed, to stay below the fuse rating. Default 2.

ev_charger.title: EV charger
ev_charger.description: Map the entities that represent your charger and tune its current limits.

data_description.charger_current_entity: The number entity that sets the charger's requested current.
data_description.charger_status_entity: The sensor or binary_sensor whose state reports whether the charger is connected and/or charging.
data_description.connected_states: The raw states of the status entity above that mean "connected", separated by commas.
data_description.charging_states: The raw states of the status entity above that mean "charging", separated by commas. A state listed in both fields is treated as charging.
data_description.charger_power_entity: The sensor reporting the charger's own power draw.
data_description.min_current: Lowest current (A) the charger will ever be asked to deliver while charging. Default 6.
data_description.max_current: Highest current (A) the charger will ever be asked to deliver. Default 16.

vehicle.title: Vehicle
vehicle.description: Map the entities that represent your vehicle and tune its battery/charge-limit defaults.

data_description.ev_soc_entity: The sensor reporting the EV's state of charge (%), used by Solar and CapTar's step-up logic.
data_description.ev_battery_capacity_entity: Optional sensor reporting the EV's battery capacity (kWh). Overrides the default battery capacity below when mapped.
data_description.vehicle_charge_limit_entity: The number entity that sets the vehicle's own onboard charge-limit.
data_description.car_home_entity: The presence entity (device_tracker, person, or binary_sensor) confirming the car is home. While this is off, ongoing syncing to the charge-limit entity above is paused.
data_description.ev_battery_capacity_kwh: Default EV battery capacity (kWh) used for time-to-full and required-current calculations when no battery capacity entity is mapped. Default 75.
data_description.default_soc_limit: Charge limit (%) applied when no override is set. Default 80.

data_description.default_target_current: Charging current (A) used when no smarter mode applies. Default 10.
data_description.power_cooldown_min: Minimum time (minutes) Power mode must wait after charging stops before it may start charging again. Default 10.

data.power_respect_peak: Power mode respects the peak limit

data_description.captar_cooldown_min: Minimum time (minutes) CapTar must wait after a peak-limit breach forces it to stop before it may resume charging. Default 10.
data_description.power_respect_peak: When on, Power mode also respects the CapTar peak limit instead of ignoring it. Default on.
data_description.safety_margin_w: Power margin (W) CapTar subtracts from the effective peak limit as a safety buffer before computing the ceiling. Default 250.
data_description.max_peak_kw: Highest value (kW) the effective peak limit is allowed to resolve to. Default 4.
data_description.peak_floor_kw: Lowest value (kW) the effective peak limit is allowed to fall to. Default 2.5.
data_description.peak_grace_min: Minutes CapTar tolerates being above the peak limit before stopping charging, to absorb brief spikes. Default 2.

solar.title: Solar
solar.description: Map the entities Solar mode reads and tune its thresholds.

data_description.solar_power_entity: The sensor reporting the solar installation's own production power, used by dashboard tiles. Optional.
data_description.solar_forecast_entity: The sensor providing a solar production forecast, used to decide whether the overnight solar-reserve SOC cap applies.
data_description.solar_start_threshold_w: Solar surplus power (W) that must reach or exceed this value before Solar mode starts charging. Default 150.
data_description.solar_only_start_threshold_w: Solar surplus power (W) that must reach or exceed this value before SolarOnly mode starts charging. Default 1300.
data_description.solar_only_strategy: How SolarOnly rounds its computed amp step to a whole ampere: round up, round down, or round to nearest using the midpoint fraction below. Default round down.
data_description.solar_only_midpoint: Fractional threshold (0-1) used only when the strategy above is round-nearest: a fraction at or above this rounds up. Default 0.5.
data_description.solar_hold_min: How long (minutes) Solar keeps charging after surplus drops below its start threshold, to avoid rapid on/off cycling. Default 5.
data_description.solar_only_hold_min: How long (minutes) SolarOnly keeps charging after surplus drops below its start threshold. Default 1.
data_description.solar_cooldown_min: Minimum time (minutes) Solar/SolarOnly must wait after charging stops before it may start charging again. Default 2.
data_description.solar_restart_debounce_min: How long (minutes) a surplus crossing above the start threshold must hold continuously, while idle after having charged before, before Solar/SolarOnly restarts. Default 1.
data_description.solar_step_pp: SOC percentage-point step size used each time solar step-up raises the target SOC. Default 5.
data_description.solar_step_threshold_pp: How close (in percentage points) the SOC is allowed to get to the current target before solar step-up raises it another step. Default 2.
data_description.max_solar_soc: Highest SOC (%) solar step-up is allowed to raise the target to. Default 100.
data_description.solar_reserve_soc: Overnight SOC cap (%) reserved for solar charging the next day, applied when the forecast exceeds the threshold below. Default 60.
data_description.solar_forecast_threshold_kwh: Forecasted solar production (kWh) above which the solar-reserve SOC cap above is applied. Default 12.

deadline.title: Departure deadline
deadline.description: Map the departure-time and home-day entities used to track a deadline, and tune the plug-in reminder lead time.

data_description.departure_external_entity: Optional sensor providing the next departure time from an external source (e.g. a calendar). Leave blank to use the built-in weekly schedule instead.
data_description.home_day_external_entity: Optional external binary_sensor/input_boolean marking today as a home day, overriding the evening prompt's answer.
data_description.reminder_lead_h: How many hours before departure to send a plug-in reminder if the car isn't yet charging. Default 8.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Map the notification target and choose which notifications to send.

data_description.notification_target_entity: Optional notify-domain entity to send charging notifications and reminders to.
data_description.deadline_notice_enabled: Turn on to notify when the current charging plan won't reach the target SOC by the deadline. Default on.
data_description.plug_in_reminder_enabled: Turn on to remind you to plug in the car when it's expected home but not charging. Default on.
data_description.evening_prompt_enabled: Turn on to ask each evening whether tomorrow is a home day. Default on.
data_description.evening_prompt_time: Time of day the evening home-day prompt is sent. Default 18:00.

error.required_when_vehicle_limit_mapped: Required when the vehicle charge-limit entity is mapped
error.required_when_deadline_available: Required when departure deadline tracking is on
